messages:
maria: Kicking off prod deploy of inference-service v2.3.1 in the change window (now). Please watchdog SLO dashboards for p95 and error rate. Deploy-bot will run canary first. /cc @aj @liz

deploy-bot: [deploy] Started canary rollout: inference-service v2.3.1 -> prod canary subset=5%.

aj: seeing a small p95 bump on embeddings route, probing dashboards: https://dashboard.redwood-infra/slos/inference-service?range=15m :eyes:

liz: also getting 502 spikes from embed-worker pool, error rate up ~0.8% over baseline. rolling logs:
```
ERROR 2026-03-20T10:12:08Z embed-worker: upstream timeout id=abc123 ms=12000
```

maria: can we hold the rest of the rollout? what's canary health? deploy-bot, status?

deploy-bot: canary health=degraded -> p95 640ms (target 400ms), error_rate 0.82% (SLO alert threshold 0.5%). Pausing rollout.

neal: I can run quick debug — likely kv-cache thrash after kernel update. Suggest pin model-quant profile to q8 before continuing; or rollback to v2.3.0. If we rollback, do `deploy rollback inference-service --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary p95 spike"`

aj: +1 rollback. Pinning might still surface hidden perf regressions. prefer rollback to restore SLOs and then investigate.

maria: agree. scheduling rollback now. neal, please run post-rollback smoke checks. oncall-bot schedule?

oncall-bot: Rollback command received and executing. ETA ~2m. Notifying pager duty.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: inference-service -> v2.3.0. All canary instances replaced.

liz: post-rollback p95 back to 360ms, error_rate 0.12%. :thumbsup:

maria: great — keeping v2.3.1 pinned in staging. Neal, open a follow-up doc with traces + kernel diff. I'll write release notes to indicate blocked perf change. :memo:

neal: creating doc: https://docs.redwood/inference/v2.3.1-investigation

maria: closing thread. Thanks all. :heart:
